completion_data.completion_summary: Proved ChainComplete FrameClass.Dense ∅ (chainComplete_dense) sorry-free with standard axioms only, via a MinusFormula-typed MCS layer, canonical relations with density from DN and weak linearity from TL, and the Burgess 1984 §2.5 step-by-step ℚ-chronicle construction; landed the corollaries minusExt_iff_tmFrag_dense, minusValidIn_chainValidIn, tmMinusComplete_dense and forward_dense, wired five new modules into the aggregator, root, README inventory, theorem index (C14-pinned) and invariants baseline, and revised every docstring that called the .Dense row open or never asserted.

memory_candidates.content: L⁻-side (MinusFormula) derivations: prove the future-side theorem once in a context via minusDeductionTheorem, then obtain every past-side twin with `ofReflect (by simp [MinusFormula.reflectTime, MinusFormula.reflectTime_involution]) (futureThm φ.reflectTime)` — a one-line TR transport. Use hyp₀/hyp₁/hyp₂ positional assumption helpers instead of `by simp` membership autoparams, which break when a derived operator (neg/and) appears in unfolded form.

Burgess-style step-by-step chronicle over ℚ in Lean: represent a stage as `s : ℚ → Option Point` with a `Finset` support and a coherence proof; reduce coherence of `Function.update s r Δ` to two one-sided conditions (`coherent_upd_of`), so placement (weak linearity + Finset.max'/min' + exists_between) and interpolation (density + seriality) each supply just those; enumerate requirements with `exists_surjective_nat` composed with `Nat.unpair` so each recurs; take the limit with Classical.choose and `limit_eq_of_labelled` by monotonicity. Wrap each `Classical.choose` branch in its own `dif` def with `le_*`/`*_spec` lemmas proved by `by_cases` + `rw [dif_pos/dif_neg]` (split_ifs names are unreliable).

Repo gates that bite after a green scoped build: `--wfail` rejects `show` (use `change`) and >100-char lines even inside docstrings; the C16 env-linter rejects underscores in `def` names (theorems may keep snake_case); C15 requires every theorem-index row's declaration docstring to carry `Paper: <anchor>` or `Paper: — (reason)`; the README inventory must be re-emitted after any line-count change; any docstring edit invalidates dependents' oleans, so the final full build must be re-run after the last prose edit.

reflection.what_worked: Writing each module against a concrete API design for the downstream phases, elaborating with `lake env lean` before the guarded build, and using MCS-level membership lemmas (imp_mem_iff, and_mem_iff, mp_of_theorem) so canonical-frame proofs stay short.
reflection.what_was_hard: Style and naming gates surfaced only at the final invariants run (underscored def names, Paper: lines, long docstring lines), forcing two extra full builds; Finset extrema proofs needed care with proof-irrelevant `Nonempty` witnesses inside `max'`.
reflection.what_was_missed: The Mathlib naming linter for defs and the C15 Paper-line rule were not anticipated in the plan; the first full build was started before the last docstring edits landed, so its verdict had to be discarded.
reflection.successes: All five Goal theorems proved with standard axioms and zero sorries, every gate green, seven phases closed and committed individually.

next_steps: None for this task; the .RTime row remains open and a lean4 pattern note on the TR-mirroring/chronicle idioms is a possible follow-up task.
